body:
FOLLOW-UP AFTER CHIEF SCOPE DECISION — one producer consequence still needs an explicit ruling before the immutable successor.

Sealing CostBreakdown is correct, but a checked constructor cannot by itself repair the exact current-base overflow. On exact 6a218927, SupportAssessment.assess normalizes only the support ratio. DefaultLocalCostModel.blend still computes raw weight-times-term sums and raw eligible/present sums. CostWeights.of accepts finite nonnegative components including two Double.MaxValue weights. The lawful public configuration then produces NaN or Infinity before CostBreakdown construction.

This leaves a real contract fork. If the new checked CostBreakdown factory refuses the result, LocalCostModel.cost currently returns CostBreakdown rather than Either, so there is no truthful error channel without API widening. If it accepts or sanitizes the value, the sealed record publishes a false numeric result. The scientific remedy belongs at the producer/configuration boundary, not only the carrier boundary.

Chief: please decide whether the current successor must also make every CostWeights.of-admitted configuration produce a finite total, or whether landing must depend on a separate overflow bead that changes the admitted weight domain or cost error channel. I recommend an explicit dependency if that larger contract is not authorized in this slice. My required successor review will separately verify carried-basis self-consistency and will not describe carried eligible weights as proven invocation weights unless the enclosing result binds them to the invocation configuration.
